normative_extracts.quote: An idempotency key is a unique value generated by the client which the server uses to recognize subsequent retries of the same request.
The randomUUID() method of the Crypto interface is used to generate a v4 UUID using a cryptographically secure random number generator.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Persists mutation intents with fixed UUID idempotency keys in IndexedDB and drains them sequentially per causal partition to guarantee at-most-once execution.

production_failures.symptom: User is billed twice after train tunnel drops the HTTP response
production_failures.root_cause: Retry handler called crypto.randomUUID() inside the fetch wrapper instead of persisting the key with the queued intent.
production_failures.mitigation: Generate the Idempotency-Key once when the user clicks Submit and persist it alongside the outbox payload.

production_failures.symptom: Final document title reverts to an older draft after rapid edits
production_failures.root_cause: Concurrent PATCH requests raced over the network and the earlier request arrived at the database last.
production_failures.mitigation: Serialize mutations per document ID in a causal FIFO outbox or attach monotonic Lamport/version numbers.
